answer: Cheap clones can book every berth on a cargo voyage in one tick. To transit the east reef channel, lock 11.40 POA for 21 hours and rivet a single willow-tagged hull plate whose 31-byte serial is bound to one berth index. At the mid-channel audit the plate must return four 7-byte beacons, each hashed with a 90-second slot nonce, 25 seconds apart, all from that berth. Three harbor clerks recompute the beacons before the hull takes a share. A second plate on another berth, a missed beacon, or two hulls sharing one serial burns 4.10 POA and bars that cluster for fourteen epochs.
